readings.title: The Camp of the East
readings.subtitle: Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun
readings.text: [Numbers 2:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh and to Aharon, saying, [2] <dq>“The children of Yisra’ĕl are to camp, each one by his own banner, beside the sign of his father’s house. They are to camp around the Tent of Appointment, at a distance.</dq> [3] <dq>“And those camping on the east side, toward the rising of the sun, are of the banner of the camp of Yehuḏah, according to their divisions. And the leader of the children of Yehuḏah is Naḥshon son of Amminaḏaḇ,</dq> [4] <dq>and his army, and those registered, are seventy-four thousand six hundred.</dq> [5] <dq>“And those camping next to him is the tribe of Yissasḵar. And the leader of the children of Yissasḵar is Nethan’ĕl son of Tsu‛ar,</dq> [6] <dq>and his army, and those registered, are fifty-four thousand four hundred.</dq> [7] <dq>“Then the tribe of Zeḇulun. And the leader of the children of Zeḇulun is Eli’aḇ son of Ḥĕlon,</dq> [8] <dq>and his army, and those registered, are fifty-seven thousand four hundred.</dq> [9] <dq>“All those registered in the camp of Yehuḏah were one hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. These break camp first.</dq>

readings.title: The Camp of the South
readings.subtitle: Reuben, Simeon, and Gad
readings.text: [Numbers 2:10] <dq>“On the south side is the banner of the camp of Re’uḇĕn, according to their divisions. And the leader of the children of Re’uḇĕn is Eli’tsur son of Shede’ur,</dq> [11] <dq>and his army, and those registered, are forty-six thousand five hundred.</dq> [12] <dq>“And those camping next to him is the tribe of Shim‛on. And the leader of the children of Shim‛on is Shelumi’ĕl son of Tsurishaddai,</dq> [13] <dq>and his army, and those registered, are fifty-nine thousand three hundred.</dq> [14] <dq>“Then the tribe of Gaḏ. And the leader of the children of Gaḏ is Elyasaph son of Re‛u’ĕl,</dq> [15] <dq>and his army, and those registered, are forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.</dq> [16] <dq>“All those registered in the camp of Re’uḇĕn were one hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty, according to their divisions. And they break camp second.</dq> [17] <dq>“And the Tent of Appointment shall move out with the camp of the Lĕvites in the middle of the camps. As they camp, so they move out, everyone in his place, by their banners.</dq>

readings.title: The Camp of the West
readings.subtitle: Ephraim, Manasseh, and Benjamin
readings.text: [Numbers 2:18] <dq>“On the west side is the banner of the camp of Ephrayim, according to their divisions. And the leader of the children of Ephrayim is Elishama son of Ammihuḏ,</dq> [19] <dq>and his army, and those registered, are forty thousand five hundred.</dq> [20] <dq>“And next to him is the tribe of Menashsheh. And the leader of the children of Menashsheh is Gamli’ĕl son of Peḏahtsur,</dq> [21] <dq>and his army, and those registered, are thirty-two thousand two hundred.</dq> [22] <dq>“Then the tribe of Binyamin. And the leader of the children of Binyamin is Aḇiḏan son of Giḏ‛oni,</dq> [23] <dq>and his army, and those registered, are thirty-five thousand four hundred.</dq> [24] <dq>“All those registered in the camp of Ephrayim were one hundred and eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. And they break camp third.</dq>

readings.title: The Camp of the North
readings.subtitle: Dan, Asher, and Naphtali
readings.text: [Numbers 2:25] <dq>“On the north side is the banner of the camp of Dan, according to their divisions. And the leader of the children of Dan is Aḥi‛ezer son of Ammishaddai,</dq> [26] <dq>and his army, and those registered, are sixty-two thousand seven hundred.</dq> [27] <dq>“And those camping next to him is the tribe of Ashĕr. And the leader of the children of Ashĕr is Paḡ’i’ĕl son of Oḵran,</dq> [28] <dq>and his army, and those registered, are forty-one thousand five hundred.</dq> [29] <dq>“Then the tribe of Naphtali. And the leader of the children of Naphtali is Aḥira son of Ěnan,</dq> [30] <dq>and his army, and those registered, are fifty-three thousand four hundred.</dq> [31] <dq>“All those registered in the camp of Dan were one hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They break camp last, with their banners.”</dq> [32] These were those registered of the children of Yisra’ĕl by their fathers’ houses. All who were registered according to their divisions of the camps were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty. [33] But the Lĕvites were not registered among the children of Yisra’ĕl, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh. [34] And the children of Yisra’ĕl did according to all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh. So they camped by their banners and so they broke camp, each one by his clan, according to his fathers’ house.

readings.title: The Line of Aaron
readings.subtitle: Service of the Priesthood
readings.text: [Numbers 3:1] And these are the genealogies of Aharon and Mosheh on the day that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke with <dn>את</dn> Mosheh on Mount Sinai: [2] And these are the names of the sons of Aharon: Naḏaḇ, the first-born, and Aḇihu, El‛azar, and Ithamar. [3] These are the names of the sons of Aharon, the anointed priests, whom he ordained to serve as priests. [4] And Naḏaḇ and Aḇihu died before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> when they offered strange fire before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in the Wilderness of Sinai. And they had no children. So El‛azar and Ithamar served as priests in the presence of Aharon their father.

readings.title: Dedication of the Levites
readings.subtitle: Given to Aaron
readings.text: [Numbers 3:5] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [6] <dq>“Bring <dn>את</dn> the tribe of Lĕwi near, and present <dn>את</dn> them before Aharon the priest, and they shall serve him.</dq> [7] <dq>“And they shall guard <dn>את</dn> his duty and <dn>את</dn> the duty of all the congregation before the Tent of Appointment, to do <dn>את</dn> the service of the Dwelling Place.</dq> [8] <dq>“And they shall guard <dn>את</dn> all the furnishings of the Tent of Appointment, and <dn>את</dn> the duty of the children of Yisra’ĕl, to do the service of the Dwelling Place.</dq> [9] <dq>“And you shall give <dn>את</dn> the Lĕvites to Aharon and his sons. They are given, given to him from among the children of Yisra’ĕl.</dq> [10] <dq>“And you shall appoint <dn>את</dn> Aharon and <dn>את</dn> his sons, and they shall guard <dn>את</dn> their priesthood. And the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”</dq> [11] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [12] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn>, see, <dn>I</dn> have taken <dn>את</dn> the Lĕvites from among the children of Yisra’ĕl instead of every first-born who opens the womb among the children of Yisra’ĕl. And the Lĕvites shall be <dn>Mine</dn>,</dq> [13] <dq>because all the first-born are <dn>Mine</dn>. On the day that <dn>I</dn> struck all the first-born in the land of Mitsrayim, <dn>I</dn> set apart to <dn>Myself</dn> all the first-born in Yisra’ĕl, whether man or beast. They are <dn>Mine</dn>, <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.”</dq>

readings.title: Numbering the Levites
readings.subtitle: The Clans of Levi
readings.text: [Numbers 3:14] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying, [15] <dq>“Register <dn>את</dn> the children of Lĕwi by their fathers’ houses, by their clans. You register every male from a month old and above.”</dq> [16] And Mosheh registered <dn>את</dn> them according to the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, as he was commanded. [17] And these were the sons of Lĕwi by their names: Gĕrshon, and Qehath, and Merari. [18] And these are the names of the sons of Gĕrshon by their clans: Liḇni and Shim‛i. [19] And the sons of Qehath by their clans: Amram, and Yitshar, Ḥebron, and Uzzi’ĕl. [20] And the sons of Merari by their clans: Maḥli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Lĕvites by their fathers’ houses.

readings.title: The Gershonites
readings.subtitle: Guardians of the Coverings
readings.text: [Numbers 3:21] Of Gĕrshon was the clan of the Liḇnites and the clan of the Shim‛ites. These were the clans of the Gĕrshonites. [22] Those registered, according to the number of all the males from a month old and above – those registered were seven thousand five hundred. [23] The clans of the Gĕrshonites were to camp behind the Dwelling Place westward. [24] And the leader of the fathers’ house of the Gĕrshonites was Elyasaph son of La’ĕl. [25] And the duty of the children of Gĕrshon in the Tent of Appointment was the Dwelling Place, and the tent with its covering, and the covering of the entrance of the Tent of Appointment, [26] and <dn>את</dn> the screens of the courtyard, and <dn>את</dn> the covering of the entrance of the courtyard that is around the Dwelling Place and around the altar, and <dn>את</dn> their cords, according to all its service.

readings.title: The Kohathites
readings.subtitle: Guardians of the Set-Apart Vessels
readings.text: [Numbers 3:27] And of Qehath was the clan of the Amramites, and the clan of the Yitsharites, and the clan of the Ḥebronites, and the clan of the Uzzi’ĕlites. These were the clans of the Qehathites. [28] According to the number of all the males, from a month old and above, were eight thousand six hundred, guarding the duty of the Set-apart Place. [29] The clans of the children of Qehath were to camp on the south side of the Dwelling Place. [30] And the leader of the fathers’ house of the clans of the Qehathites was Elitsaphan son of Uzzi’ĕl. [31] And their duty was the ark, and the table, and the lampstand, and the altars, and the utensils of the Set-apart Place with which they served, and the screen, and all its service. [32] And the leader of the leaders of the Lĕvites was El‛azar, son of Aharon the priest, overseer of those who guarded the duty of the Set-apart Place.

readings.title: The Merarites
readings.subtitle: Guardians of the Framework
readings.text: [Numbers 3:33] Of Merari was the clan of the Maḥlites and the clan of the Mushites. These were the clans of Merari. [34] And those registered, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and above, were six thousand two hundred. [35] And the leader of the fathers’ house of the clans of Merari was Tsuru’ĕl son of Aḇiḥayil. They were to camp on the north side of the Dwelling Place. [36] And the appointed duty of the children of Merari was the boards of the Dwelling Place, and its bars, and its columns, and its sockets, and all its utensils, and all its service, [37] and the columns of the courtyard all around, with their sockets, and their pegs, and their cords. [38] And those who camped before the Dwelling Place on the east, before the Tent of Appointment toward the rising of the sun, were Mosheh and Aharon and his sons, guarding the duty of the Set-apart Place, to meet the duty for the children of Yisra’ĕl. And the stranger who comes near is put to death. [39] All those registered of the Lĕvites, whom Mosheh and Aharon registered at the command of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, by their clans, all the males from a month old and above, were twenty-two thousand.

readings.title: The Redemption of the First-born
readings.subtitle: Exchange of the Levites
readings.text: [Numbers 3:40] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Mosheh, <dq>“Register <dn>את</dn> all the first-born males of the children of Yisra’ĕl from a month old and above, and take <dn>את</dn> the number of their names.</dq> [41] <dq>“And you shall take <dn>את</dn> the Lĕvites for <dn>Me</dn> – <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – instead of all the first-born among the children of Yisra’ĕl, and <dn>את</dn> the livestock of the Lĕvites instead of all the first-born among the livestock of the children of Yisra’ĕl.”</dq> [42] And Mosheh registered <dn>את</dn> all the first-born among the children of Yisra’ĕl, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded him. [43] And all the first-born males by the number of names, from a month old and above, of those registered, were twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three. [44] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [45] <dq>“Take <dn>את</dn> the Lĕvites instead of all the first-born among the children of Yisra’ĕl, and <dn>את</dn> the livestock of the Lĕvites instead of their livestock. And the Lĕvites shall be <dn>Mine</dn>, <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [46] <dq>“And for <dn>את</dn> the ransom of the two hundred and seventy-three first-born of the children of Yisra’ĕl who are more than the number of the Lĕvites,</dq> [47] <dq>you shall take five sheqels for each one by the skull, take it according to the sheqel of the set-apart place, twenty gĕrahs to the sheqel.</dq> [48] <dq>“And you shall give the silver, the ransom for those who exceed the number of them, to Aharon and his sons.”</dq> [49] And Mosheh took <dn>את</dn> the ransom silver from those who exceeded the number redeemed by the Lĕvites. [50] From the first-born of the children of Yisra’ĕl he took <dn>את</dn> the silver, one thousand three hundred and sixty-five sheqels, according to the sheqel of the set-apart place. [51] And Mosheh gave <dn>את</dn> the silver of the ones ransomed to Aharon and his sons, according to the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded Mosheh.
